### Read and format data
```{r reading_data}

reference <- LoadH5Seurat("Data/pbmc_multimodal.h5seurat")

# there are also 3 and 7 days post HIV vaccination
DimPlot(reference, split.by = "time", reduction = "wnn.umap", group.by = "celltype.l2") 



# Remove post vaccination timepoints
Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$time

reference <- subset(reference, ident = "0")

unique(reference@meta.data$time)

Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$celltype.l1


```

### Define cytotoxicity markers
```{r Cytotoxicity_markers}

cytotoxic.markers <- c("GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMA", "GZMB", "GZMK", "GZMM", "GZMH") 

```

### Visualising NKG7 expression
```{r Visualising_NKG7}

if(!dir.exists("output/figures/NKG7_Expression")){
  dir.create("output/figures/NKG7_Expression", 
             recursive = T)}


head(reference@meta.data)


p1 <- DimPlot(object = reference, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
              group.by = "celltype.l2",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()

p1
dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/NKG7_Expression/WNN_UMAP_subset_annotation.pdf")
dev.off()


NKG7 <- FeaturePlot(reference,
                    "NKG7",
                    reduction = "wnn.umap",
                    order = TRUE)

NKG7
dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/NKG7_Expression/WNN_UMAP_NKG7_Expression.pdf")
dev.off()

p1 + NKG7

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/NKG7_Expression/WNN_UMAP_subset_annotation_and_NKG7_Expression.pdf")
dev.off()


Nebulosa::plot_density(reference, 
                       features = "NKG7", 
                       reduction = "wnn.umap")

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/NKG7_Expression/WNN_UMAP_NKG7_Expression_density.pdf")
dev.off()



####################################################################################
# loop through a number of cytotoxicity markers and plot expression pattern 
####################################################################################

for(i in seq_along(cytotoxic.markers)){

  
  temp.plot <- FeaturePlot(reference,
                         cytotoxic.markers[i],
                         reduction = "wnn.umap",
                         order = TRUE)
ggsave(paste0("output/figures/NKG7_Expression/WNN_UMAP_",  cytotoxic.markers[i], "_Expression.pdf"))
rm(temp.plot)

}



```

### NKG7 expression vln plots
```{r Vln_NKG7_expression}

if(!dir.exists("output/figures/NKG7_Expression")){
  dir.create("output/figures/NKG7_Expression", 
             recursive = T)}


# Set up dataset
DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"
reference # 20,957 genes and 161,764 cells 

Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$celltype.l1


VlnPlot(reference, 
        feature = "NKG7",
        pt.size = 0, 
        group.by = "celltype.l2",
        sort = "increasing",
        log = FALSE) + NoLegend()

dev.copy(pdf, "output/figures/NKG7_Expression/VlnPlot_NKG7_Expression_cell_subsets_L2.pdf")
dev.off()


```

### Correlation analysis - All cells
```{r correlation_analysis_All_Cells}


# Set up dataset
DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"
reference # 20,957 genes and 161,764 cells 


# dataset is very large, downsample for correlation analysis 

length(unique(reference@meta.data$celltype.l2)) # 31 cell type annotations

Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$celltype.l2

downsampled.seurat <- subset(reference, 
                             downsample = 1500)

normed.data <- as.matrix(downsampled.seurat@assays$SCT@data)



cor.df <- sc.correlation(normed.data, 
                           goi = "NKG7", 
                           remove.quantile = 0.3,
                           output.tables = "output/tables/Correlation_analysis")



################################
# Heatmap of top correlations
################################
DefaultAssay(downsampled.seurat) <- "SCT"
Idents(downsampled.seurat) <- downsampled.seurat@meta.data$celltype.l2

small.seurat <- subset(downsampled.seurat, 
                       downsample = 100)

small.seurat <- ScaleData(small.seurat)

correlation.heatmaps(small.seurat, 
                     correlation.df = cor.df, 
                     up.n = 40, # number of up regulated genes to show
                     dn.n = 20, # number of downregulated genes to show
                     goi = "NKG7", 
                     output.figures = "output/figures/Correlation_analysis")

```

### Boolean cytotoxicity expression
```{r Boolean_Cytotoxicity}


if(!dir.exists("output/figures/Vln_cytotoxicity")){
  dir.create("output/figures/Vln_cytotoxicity", 
             recursive = T)}



# Using boolean logic to define cells as single or multiple positive for cytotoxic molecules 
DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"
Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$celltype.l2

# Markers
cytotoxic.markers <- c("GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMA", "GZMB", "GZMK", "GZMM", "GZMH") 

for(i in seq_along(cytotoxic.markers)){
  
  
  print(VlnPlot(reference, 
                feature = cytotoxic.markers[i], 
                pt.size = 0)
        + NoLegend())
  
  
  dev.copy(pdf, paste0("output/figures/Vln_cytotoxicity/Vln_", cytotoxic.markers[i], ".pdf"))
  dev.off()
  
}

# Expression level above 0.5 seems to capture positive or negative cells decently 


for(i in seq_along(cytotoxic.markers)){
  
  
logic.var <- grep(paste0("^", cytotoxic.markers[i], "$"),
                  rownames(reference@assays$SCT@data))

expression.vector <- reference@assays$SCT@data[logic.var, ]

expression.logic <- expression.vector > 1


reference <- AddMetaData(reference, 
            metadata = expression.logic, 
            col.name = paste0(cytotoxic.markers[i], "_Exp"))

}


# calculate single, double, triple etc positive cells 

pattern <- paste0(paste0(cytotoxic.markers, "_Exp"), collapse = "|")
keep.logic <- grepl(pattern, colnames(reference@meta.data))

cytotoxic.meta <- reference@meta.data[, keep.logic]

cytotoxic.boolean <- rowSums(cytotoxic.meta)


reference <- AddMetaData(reference, 
                         metadata = cytotoxic.boolean, 
                         col.name = "Cytotoxic_Boolean")

# remove all non-cytotoxic cells 
Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$Cytotoxic_Boolean
summary(reference@meta.data$Cytotoxic_Boolean)


n.val <- max(reference@meta.data$Cytotoxic_Boolean)
cytotoxic.seurat <- subset(reference, idents = c(3:n.val))



cytotoxic.seurat

DimPlot(object = cytotoxic.seurat, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
              group.by = "celltype.l3",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend()




DimPlot(object = cytotoxic.seurat, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
              split.by = "Cytotoxic_Boolean",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend()



small.seurat <- subset(reference, downsample = 300)
small.seurat <- ScaleData(small.seurat)



DoHeatmap(small.seurat, 
          group.by = "Cytotoxic_Boolean", 
          features = c(cytotoxic.markers, "NKG7"))

DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"


reference@meta.data$cells <- "ALL_cells"


VlnPlot(reference, 
        feature = "NKG7",
        group.by = "cells", pt.size = 0)




logic.var <- grep("^NKG7$",
                  rownames(reference@assays$SCT@data))

expression.vector <- reference@assays$SCT@data[logic.var, ]
summary(expression.vector)

no.NKG7 <- expression.vector == 0
dim.NKG7 <- expression.vector > 0 & expression.vector <= 1
mid.NKG7 <- expression.vector > 1 & expression.vector <= 3
high.NKG7 <- expression.vector > 3

NKG7.meta <- expression.vector
NKG7.meta[no.NKG7] <- "No_NKG7"
NKG7.meta[dim.NKG7] <- "dim_NKG7"
NKG7.meta[mid.NKG7] <- "mid_NKG7"
NKG7.meta[high.NKG7] <- "high_NKG7"

unique(NKG7.meta)



reference <- AddMetaData(reference, 
            metadata = NKG7.meta, 
            col.name = "NKG7_stratify")




VlnPlot(reference, 
        feature = "NKG7",
        group.by = "NKG7_stratify", pt.size = 0)



DimPlot(object = reference, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
              split.by = "NKG7_stratify",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend()



table(reference@meta.data$NKG7_stratify, reference@meta.data$celltype.l2)


Idents(reference) <- reference@meta.data$NKG7_stratify

small.seurat <- subset(reference, downsample = 300)
small.seurat <- ScaleData(small.seurat)

DoHeatmap(small.seurat, 
          group.by = "NKG7_stratify", 
          features = c(cytotoxic.markers, "NKG7"))

DefaultAssay(reference) <- "SCT"


prop.table(table(reference@meta.data$Cytotoxic_Boolean))*100



DimPlot(object = reference, 
              reduction = "wnn.umap",
        group.by = "celltype.l2",
              split.by = "Cytotoxic_Boolean",
              label = TRUE, 
              label.size = 3, 
              repel = TRUE) + 
  NoLegend()



```
